svg.text: core PT pine 4x6 S4S, ground contact (UC4B)
core PT pine 4x6 S4S, ground contact (UC4B)
HOLES: lay out 7 post centers at 3'-7 1/4" o.c.; dig Ø16" x 3'-6" with rented machine auger; 6" gravel.
POSTS: set PT pine 4x6 S4S, ground contact (UC4B) cores 3'-0" deep, plumb and brace, concrete with sloped collar. Cure 48 h.
LEVEL TOPS: cut all cores to 7'-8" above grade (laser level).
NOTCHED SIDE BOARDS (pre-cut): fasten to core sides from the neighbor side, notches facing neighbor.
SLATS (pre-cut): drop into notches from the neighbor side, bottom to top; 1 screw per end.
FRONT CLOSURE: Cedar 2x6 S4S face boards on both faces (closes the notches and locks the slats).
SIDE CLOSURE: Cedar 5/4x6 S4S plain on the outer side of end posts 1 and 7.
BEAMS (pre-notched): Cedar 2x8 S4S each side, bolted straight to the core above the face boards, 4 x 1/2" thru-bolts per post; splice over post 4.
PERGOLA RAFTERS (pre-cut): 13 into top-board notches (posts + mid-bay); hidden trim-head screws.
Kitchen Privacy Screen — 7 posts, cedar, 8 ft, pergola top
Clad post (PT core + cladding) and installation
Dimensions in feet/inches. Lumber: actual sizes (2x6 = 1 1/2" x 5 1/2").
Verify all dimensions in the field before cutting. Not a structural design.
